tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// lam zab kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi 'grel pa bzhugs//

༄༅// skyil krung lag bcag sar btsugs lus bsrangs nas// hing hūm̐ hag hig dang sbyar sbyor ba drug /tshangs pas 'khor lo bzhi la 'dren pas dgug /lus mtshungs lag g.yas sar gatshugs g.yon pa yi// mtheb srin gyis ni nyi zla'i rgyu ba mnan// nyams skyes lus kun g.yas g.yon dal bur bcud// mtha' mar thub tshad rlung mnan bcing ba yin// seng ge rnam grol phyag rgyas lus bskor zhing*// rlung mnan lus 'dar de srid mtha' mar ni// lag pa bskor zhing lus phag rkang pa gnyis| /brkyang ba stabs gcig gis krug bsdams pa yin// rlung mnan khru gang stegs su phongs gzhag cing*/ rkang pa gnyis gshibs khu tshur phyag rgya steng*// rkyong dang langs pa nu khar dbab dang sdeb// bstun pa mnyes par byed pa'i 'khrul 'khor gsung*// mchog gi lam du chas par 'dod pa yi// cha med rgyus gtam smra ba'i phyir 'brangs kyang*// 'don pa'i re ba 'grub pa'i gnas skabs bral// de phyir cer mthong lag khrid shes la nyon// //dge'o// //
